fullText.simplified:
找到毒药

    冷警官决定再去一次钱老板的公司，他要调查清楚关于那杯咖啡的事情。
    咖啡是谢秘书做的。那天谢秘书在九点的时候，去咖啡机那儿做了一杯咖啡，然后她去了洗手间。白秘书九点十分到了公司，她马上跑到咖啡机那儿，拿了咖啡就去了钱老板的办公室。谢秘书从洗手间回来的时候，又去了咖啡机那儿，应该是想给钱老板送咖啡，但是她看见白秘书从老板办公室里出来了。除了她们两个人，没有别人拿过那杯咖啡。
    现在两个女人都在警局里，冷警官决定去她们的家里检查一下，看看能不能发现有用的东西。
    三个小时以后，冷警官和同事们在白秘书的家里发现了毒药，这个毒药就是钱老板咖啡里的那种。现在事情应该很清楚了，白秘书和她的丈夫骗了钱老板两千万，然后被钱老板发现了，白秘书没有办法，只能杀了钱老板。
    冷警官回到了警局，他准备把毒药放在白秘书的眼前，看她还有什么要说的。这个女人先跟别人说自己是单身，然后又说三个月前才认识高老板，她还说自己没杀人，她的话不能相信！
fullText.traditional:
找到毒藥

    冷警官決定再去一次錢老闆的公司，他要調查清楚關於那杯咖啡的事情。
    咖啡是謝秘書做的。那天謝秘書在九點的時候，去咖啡機那兒做了一杯咖啡，然後她去了洗手間。白秘書九點十分到了公司，她馬上跑到咖啡機那兒，拿了咖啡就去了錢老闆的辦公室。謝秘書從洗手間回來的時候，又去了咖啡機那兒，應該是想給錢老闆送咖啡，但是她看見白秘書從老闆辦公室裡出來了。除了她們兩個人，沒有別人拿過那杯咖啡。
    現在兩個女人都在警局裡，冷警官決定去她們的家裡檢查一下，看看能不能發現有用的東西。
    三個小時以後，冷警官和同事們在白秘書的家裡發現了毒藥，這個毒藥就是錢老闆咖啡裡的那種。現在事情應該很清楚了，白秘書和她的丈夫騙了錢老闆兩千萬，然後被錢老闆發現了，白秘書沒有辦法，只能殺了錢老闆。
    冷警官回到了警局，他準備把毒藥放在白秘書的眼前，看她還有什麼要說的。這個女人先跟別人說自己是單身，然後又說三個月前才認識高老闆，她還說自己沒殺人，她的話不能相信！

sentences.english: He wanted to clearly investigate the matters surrounding that cup of coffee.

sentences.simplified: 咖啡是谢秘书做的。
sentences.traditional: 咖啡是謝秘書做的。

sentences.english: The coffee was made by Secretary Xie.

sentences.simplified: 那天谢秘书在九点的时候，去咖啡机那儿做了一杯咖啡，然后她去了洗手间。
sentences.traditional: 那天謝秘書在九點的時候，去咖啡機那兒做了一杯咖啡，然後她去了洗手間。

sentences.english: That day at 9 o’clock, Secretary Xie went to the coffee machine to make a cup of coffee. Then she went to the bathroom.

sentences.simplified: 白秘书九点十分到了公司，
sentences.traditional: 白秘書九點十分到了公司，
sentences.pinyin: bái mì shū jiǔ diǎn shí fēn dào le gōng sī
sentences.english: Secretary Bai arrived at the office at 9:10.

sentences.simplified: 她马上跑到咖啡机那儿，拿了咖啡就去了钱老板的办公室。
sentences.traditional: 她馬上跑到咖啡機那兒，拿了咖啡就去了錢老闆的辦公室。
sentences.pinyin: tā mǎ shàng pǎo dào kā fēi jī nà'r ná le kā fēi jiù qù le qián lǎo bǎn de bàn gōng shì
sentences.english: She immediately rushed to the coffee machine, took the coffee, and went to Boss Qian’s office.

sentences.simplified: 谢秘书从洗手间回来的时候，又去了咖啡机那儿，
sentences.traditional: 謝秘書從洗手間回來的時候，又去了咖啡機那兒，
sentences.pinyin: xiè mì shū cóng xǐ shǒu jiān huí lái de shí hou yòu qù le kā fēi jī nà'r
sentences.english: When Secretary Xie came back from the bathroom, she went to the coffee machine again.

sentences.simplified: 应该是想给钱老板送咖啡，但是她看见白秘书从老板办公室里出来了。
sentences.traditional: 應該是想給錢老闆送咖啡，但是她看見白秘書從老闆辦公室裡出來了。
sentences.pinyin: yīng gāi shì xiǎng gěi qián lǎo bǎn sòng kā fēi dàn shì tā kàn jiàn bái mì shū cóng lǎo bǎn bàn gōng shì lǐ chū lái le
sentences.english: She probably wanted to give the coffee to Boss Qian, but she saw Secretary Bai walking out of the boss’s office.

sentences.simplified: 除了她们两个人，没有别人拿过那杯咖啡。
sentences.traditional: 除了她們兩個人，沒有別人拿過那杯咖啡。
sentences.pinyin: chú le tā men liǎng ge rén méi yǒu bié ren ná guò nà bēi kā fēi
sentences.english: Aside from the two of them, no one else had held that cup of coffee.

sentences.simplified: 现在两个女人都在警局里，
sentences.traditional: 現在兩個女人都在警局裡，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài liǎng ge nǚ rén dōu zài jǐng jú lǐ
sentences.english: Now, both women were at the police station.

sentences.simplified: 冷警官决定去她们的家里检查一下，看看能不能发现有用的东西。
sentences.traditional: 冷警官決定去她們的家裡檢查一下，看看能不能發現有用的東西。
sentences.pinyin: lěng jǐng guān jué dìng qù tā men de jiā lǐ jiǎn chá yí xià kàn kan néng bù néng fā xiàn yǒu yòng de dōng xi
sentences.english: Officer Leng decided to go to their homes and see if he could find anything useful.

sentences.simplified: 三个小时以后，冷警官和同事们在白秘书的家里发现了毒药，
sentences.traditional: 三個小時以後，冷警官和同事們在白秘書的家裡發現了毒藥，
sentences.pinyin: sān ge xiǎo shí yǐ hòu lěng jǐng guān hé tóng shì men zài bái mì shū de jiā lǐ fā xiàn le dú yào
sentences.english: Three hours later, Officer Leng and his colleagues found poison in Secretary Bai’s home.

sentences.simplified: 这个毒药就是钱老板咖啡里的那种。
sentences.traditional: 這個毒藥就是錢老闆咖啡裡的那種。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge dú yào jiù shì qián lǎo bǎn kā fēi lǐ de nà zhǒng
sentences.english: It was the same kind of poison as was in Boss Qian’s coffee.

sentences.simplified: 现在事情应该很清楚了，白秘书和她的丈夫骗了钱老板两千万，
sentences.traditional: 現在事情應該很清楚了，白秘書和她的丈夫騙了錢老闆兩千萬，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài shì qing yīng gāi hěn qīng chu le bái mì shū hé tā de zhàng fu piàn le qián lǎo bǎn liǎng qiān wàn
sentences.english: Things should be very clear now. Secretary Bai and her husband cheated 20 million from Boss Qian.

sentences.simplified: 然后被钱老板发现了，白秘书没有办法，只能杀了钱老板。
sentences.traditional: 然後被錢老闆發現了，白秘書沒有辦法，只能殺了錢老闆。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu bèi qián lǎo bǎn fā xiàn le bái mì shū méi yǒu bàn fǎ zhǐ néng shā le qián lǎo bǎn
sentences.english: Then they were discovered by Boss Qian. Secretary Bai had no choice but to kill Boss Qian.

sentences.simplified: 冷警官回到了警局，
sentences.traditional: 冷警官回到了警局，
sentences.pinyin: lěng jǐng guān huí dào le jǐng jú
sentences.english: Officer Leng returned to the police station.

sentences.simplified: 他准备把毒药放在白秘书的眼前，看她还有什么要说的。
sentences.traditional: 他準備把毒藥放在白秘書的眼前，看她還有什麼要說的。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǔn bèi bǎ dú yào fàng zài bái mì shū de yǎn qián kàn tā hái yǒu shén me yào shuō de
sentences.english: He was going to put the poison in front of Secretary Bai to see if she had anything else to say.

sentences.simplified: 这个女人先跟别人说自己是单身，然后又说三个月前才认识高老板，

sentences.english: This woman first told others that she was single, and then said that she had only met Boss Gao three months ago.

sentences.simplified: 她还说自己没杀人，她的话不能相信！
sentences.traditional: 她還說自己沒殺人，她的話不能相信！
sentences.pinyin: tā hái shuō zì jǐ méi shā rén tā de huà bù néng xiāng xìn
sentences.english: And now she’s saying that she didn’t kill anyone. You can’t trust what she says!

sentence_translations: Found the Poison
Officer Leng decided to go to Boss Qian’s office building again.
He wanted to clearly investigate the matters surrounding that cup of coffee.
The coffee was made by Secretary Xie.
That day at 9 o’clock, Secretary Xie went to the coffee machine to make a cup of coffee. Then she went to the bathroom.
Secretary Bai arrived at the office at 9:10.
She immediately rushed to the coffee machine, took the coffee, and went to Boss Qian’s office.
When Secretary Xie came back from the bathroom, she went to the coffee machine again.
She probably wanted to give the coffee to Boss Qian, but she saw Secretary Bai walking out of the boss’s office.
Aside from the two of them, no one else had held that cup of coffee.
Now, both women were at the police station.
Officer Leng decided to go to their homes and see if he could find anything useful.
Three hours later, Officer Leng and his colleagues found poison in Secretary Bai’s home.
It was the same kind of poison as was in Boss Qian’s coffee.
Things should be very clear now. Secretary Bai and her husband cheated 20 million from Boss Qian.
Then they were discovered by Boss Qian. Secretary Bai had no choice but to kill Boss Qian.
Officer Leng returned to the police station.
He was going to put the poison in front of Secretary Bai to see if she had anything else to say.
This woman first told others that she was single, and then said that she had only met Boss Gao three months ago.
And now she’s saying that she didn’t kill anyone. You can’t trust what she says!
